name: Design Hive
what_you_do: A paid, youth-led program for juniors and seniors. You study design objects and how designers work, then build your own team design project with other teens.
who_can_apply: High school juniors and seniors based in the New York City area. You must come to every weekly meeting at the museum.
pay_detail: $1,250 stipend after you finish the program.
duration: Tuesdays 4:30 to 6:30 PM, Jan 19 to Jun 1, 2027, with NYC school breaks off
deadline_text: Applications for 2027 are open. Apply by Sunday, Oct 25, 2026 at 11:59 PM.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the Smithsonian application system (SOLAA). The application has short answer questions, an essay and two references. The references are adults who are not related to you. A teacher or mentor works. You can save and finish later. A virtual info session was offered. See the page.
notes: Meets at 2 East 91st Street and some offsite places. The page says the demographic and citizenship questions are optional and not tied to your application. The page does not say whether a work permit is needed. Cooper Hewitt also runs free monthly Teen Drop-In workshops and a Design Career Fair.
